name: W-Arly-Pendjari Complex
description: This vast stretch of wild savannah spreads across Benin, Burkina Faso and Niger, linking W National Park with the Arli and Pendjari parks. Grasslands, scrub, open woodland and ribbons of riverside forest shelter West Africa's biggest elephant population. Lions, cheetahs, leopards and African manatees also live here, making it one of the region's last true wildlife refuges.
